purpose: Continue platform-neutral Life Continuity development while preserving every required Windows execution for one later runner and isolated-VM qualification window.
immediateDevelopmentRules: Core schemas must not contain macOS paths, Windows paths, registry identities, PIDs, or platform signals.
Every new platform effect must have a Windows adapter contract and deterministic fault test before product wiring.
Windows-only code must remain buildable or structurally testable from the committed workflow and fixture.
No missing Windows execution may be reported as pass, zero, not-applicable, or covered by macOS.
No deferred test may be deleted or weakened to close a later Gate.
